proposal.hypothesis: The selected parent’s 512-options-per-worker team cap is the best aggregate candidate so far, but measured means across OpenMP variants are close and provide no per-size crossover data. Lowering the generic grain to 64 options per worker tests whether scaling the static loop to more of the passed thread budget repays its region overhead at smaller workloads. No gain is assumed.

retained: Reduced the generic minimum work grain from 512 to 64 options per worker so the bounded static OpenMP team can scale earlier.
Retained the serial path when there is one effective worker or too little work for two grain-sized workers; the team remains bounded by the passed thread budget.
Preserved the per-option computation and complete index-based output coverage.
